fields.name: material
fields.tooltip: Skybox material on the Skybox/FiniteRunner/Hyperspace shader. The driver plays a runtime COPY of it, so the asset is never written by gameplay.

fields.name: fadeInSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds the sky takes to crossfade from the scene's skybox into hyperspace once engaged.

fields.name: fadeOutSeconds
fields.tooltip: Seconds the sky takes to fade back to the scene's skybox once released (the ship dropped below Light Speed).

fields.name: flashStrength
fields.tooltip: Burst of light the jump makes on engaging (0 = none). Fades out over Flash seconds.

fields.name: flashSeconds
fields.tooltip: How long the jump's flash takes to fade.

fields.name: axisResponse
fields.tooltip: How fast the tunnel's axis follows the ship's heading (exponential response, 1/s). Low = the vanishing point drifts lazily through curves.

fields.name: scrollSpeed
fields.tooltip: Tunnel scroll (cells per second) at the reference speed — the runner hands Light Speed.

fields.name: speedFactorBand
fields.tooltip: Scroll speed as a multiple of Scroll Speed, clamped to this band of speed ÷ reference: braking hard never stops the tunnel, a purple orb never makes it strobe.

fields.name: greenShare
fields.tooltip: Share of streaks painted green; the rest blend cyan → aqua.

fields.name: brightness
fields.tooltip: Streak brightness (HDR — above ~1 the bloom picks them up).

fields.name: columns
fields.tooltip: Angular columns round the tunnel. More = thinner, busier streaks.

fields.name: density
fields.tooltip: Share of cells that hold a streak.

fields.name: cellLength
fields.tooltip: Length of one cell along the tunnel. Shorter = more, closer streaks.

fields.name: streakLength
fields.tooltip: How much of its cell a streak fills along the tunnel.

fields.name: streakWidth
fields.tooltip: How much of its column a streak fills across.

fields.name: coreRadius
fields.tooltip: Size of the dark vanishing point (sine of the angle off the tunnel axis).
